applies_to: E006 step 6 (missing-position bounds, wave estimand, release assembly); steps 1-5 unchanged

fix_time_tolerance.question: When bounding unknown positions, widen each known GFW end by its +/-30 min time-stamp uncertainty?
fix_time_tolerance.choice: A: widen. The known position before an unknown hour is treated as up to 30 min earlier and the one after as up to 30 min later, matching the step-4 speed check (record interval + 1 h). Port endpoints keep their existing 1 h tolerance.

wave_point_estimand.question: Which value is the primary mean significant wave height?
wave_point_estimand.choice: A: primary = mean over wave-matched hours (no clipping) with its ship-cluster sampling interval, published together with the lowest/highest possible means. The clipped value is kept as a secondary field with a flag and the size of the shift; support hours, support coverage and unsupported hours are added.

coauthor_suggestion.items: AUTHOR_ACTIONS.md A06 (wave fields) and A07 (formula 8); consistent with choice A

disconnected_water.question: Connect short gaps between map-disconnected water bodies (canal lakes, harbour basins) with a straight line?
disconnected_water.choice: No change: these hours (0.13% of voyage time) stay unresolved, remain in every denominator, and keep their reachable-area bounds.
